verdict.rationale: vLLM is inherently headless. It ships a CLI that starts the OpenAI-compatible API server [vllm-docs-27], CLI benchmark commands for latency and throughput [vllm-docs-29], an offline-inference mode [vllm-docs-25], an official Docker image for deployment [vllm-docs-26], and pip/uv installation [vllm-docs-18], so it can be scripted in automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions recipes, non-interactive exit-code behavior), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
